page.title: Result and handoff
page.purpose: Review actual output quality, download direct artifacts and reopen a reproducible shot with its provenance and known portability limits.

priorities.statement: Inspect the delivered image or controlled-motion video.
Download or reuse exact artifacts and recipe.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Offer retained frames/preview with incomplete status and exact missing output.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
Technical validation may pass while visual/motion acceptance awaits human review.
Reopening preserves output inspection and offers deterministic local relink.
Show exact consumer contract and artifact hashes; no automatic publication.

claims.statement: Direct inspectable media and artifacts are primary deliverables; an HTML inspector is optional and cannot substitute for them.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

claims.statement: Recipe replay exposes missing inputs, compatibility and non-reproducible provider behavior instead of claiming bit-identical generation.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

x-design.layout: Large media player/hero with representative frame strip, direct artifact list and provenance/validation panel; view/edit recipe alongside output only on sufficient width.
controls: Play/pause/scrub video and inspect representative full-resolution stills
Compare source/capture and output with masks and color evidence
Download PNG/MP4 and explicit native blend/portable GLB/static representative classes
Export recipe/project bundle with content hashes and safe relink manifest
Reopen exact revision or duplicate for edits
Prepare launch-video/API/CLI handoff with exact paths/contracts, attribution and capabilities
details: Static GLB screen representative is never advertised as embedded playback.
Native versus portable lighting/material/precision differences and unsupported joints are stated per artifact.
Output profiles identify dimensions, fps, duration, SAR, SDR/HDR/color transform and audio policy; 4K latency is not asserted from unmeasured CPU scaling.
A manifest excludes credentials/tokens/private unrelated files and identifies retained versus external sources.
User final-look acceptance remains pending until actually provided, even when technical checks pass.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.
